name: InterContinental Cascais-Estoril
insider_take: This legendary resort sits on the Portuguese Riviera where European royalty once sought refuge during WWII, earning Estoril the nickname "Coast of Kings."
whats_special: The hotel overlooks the famous Casino Estoril - Europe's largest casino and inspiration for Ian Fleming's first James Bond novel "Casino Royale." The property seamlessly blends its storied past with modern luxury, featuring direct access to Tamariz Beach and panoramic Atlantic views from its clifftop perch.
pro_tip: Book a room facing the ocean for stunning sunrise views, and time your visit during the Estoril Open tennis tournament (April-May) when the town buzzes with international energy.
dont_miss: Stroll through the manicured gardens to Casino Estoril for an evening of gaming, catch the historic tram to nearby Sintra's fairy-tale palaces, or explore the dramatic coastline at Cabo da Roca - continental Europe's westernmost point, just 30 minutes away.
pros: Stunning Atlantic Ocean views from most rooms and public spaces
Prime location steps from the iconic Estoril Casino and sandy beaches
Elegant, well-appointed rooms with refined Portuguese-inspired décor
Exceptional dining featuring fresh local seafood and international cuisine
Highly attentive and professional service praised consistently by guests
cons: Upscale coastal resort pricing may not suit all budgets
Located outside Lisbon city center, requiring transport for urban exploration
